caption:
Google just hired an AI to answer your customers first.

Google is piloting AI-powered messaging on Business Profiles. A customer taps message from Search or Maps, and an AI agent answers using only what sits on your profile: hours, services, Q&A.

The pilot is invite-only, with no public rollout date yet.

One thing matters before it ever reaches you. A thin or outdated profile hands the customer a wrong answer before a human sees the lead. Whatever the AI can't resolve still needs a fast human reply behind it, not a callback three hours later.

Three fixes for this week:
1. Update your hours, services and prices on Google Business Profile
2. Fill out your Q&A with the questions customers actually ask
3. Put a fast response system behind whatever the AI can't answer

See what instant, automated reply looks like on your own leads. 14 days free.

rationale: News reels win cold-audience reach, and Google's invite-only AI messaging pilot on Business Profiles is a fresh, verifiable, unclaimed angle that reframes profile accuracy and speed-to-lead as the same problem.
